98080189.s: Al Salam Park in Baljurashi Governorate is a lovely family destination with a refreshing atmosphere and pleasant climate. It has children's play areas and comfortable seating for enjoying a quiet time with family.

98080188.s: Al Sakran Park, also known as "Al Wadi Park", is one of the best-known parks visited by summer holidaymakers in Baljurashi Governorate. It has a beautiful mountain view and a mosque nearby. Open 24 hours daily.

98080139.s: Al Hisn Rural Farm in Bani Hassan Governorate is a small, elegant and carefully kept farm where the owner lets visitors pick peaches straight from the trees. It has a lovely heritage museum, walking paths, and a restaurant and cafe serving cake, basbousa and tea, plus birds and horses for children to ride, and a wonderful view of the valley. Open daily from 4 to 11:30 PM. Contact: 0555519464.

98080138.s: Al Shantir Farm in Al Qura Governorate is one of the best tourist destinations in Al-Baha, combining captivating natural beauty with a calm atmosphere. It is famous for its fresh black mulberries, and has a cafe serving a variety of drinks and private seating areas overlooking the farm and fountains. Open daily from 5 AM until around midnight. Contact: 0558697074.

It also has a bird garden, giant swings, trampolines and scooters for children, amid the sound of running water and birdsong. Open daily from 4 to 11 PM. Entry is 20 SAR per family. Contact: 0502380759.

98080107.s: Al Wadi Rural Farm in Baljurashi Governorate is notable for its luxurious design and complete privacy. It has a single chalet furnished with fine furniture that accommodates a whole family, amid enchanting nature that resembles the countryside. Contact: 0553117077.

98080104.s: Al Khamis Grape Farm in Al-Baha city is known for growing grapes and fresh strawberries that can be bought directly from the farm. It also has an animal and bird section, and olives. Open daily from 6 AM to 6:30 PM. Contact: 0504426039.

98080103.s: Al Omar Rural Farm and Park in Al Mandaq Governorate is a large natural site with fruiting pomegranate and peach trees. It has a restaurant serving traditional Saudi dishes and light snacks for children, free games and inflatables, and an animal section with horses, ostriches, gazelles and rabbits that children and adults enjoy. Open daily from 8 AM to 10:30 PM. Contact: 0550056665.

98080099.s: The historic Wadi Lawmah in Ghamid Al Zinad Governorate is a natural valley with an unspoiled character, far from the bustle of cities. Its location in the far south of Al-Baha Region gives it a unique natural setting that appeals to those who love exploring and quiet.

98080098.s: Wadi Dawqah in Qilwah Governorate, "the Bride of Tihamah", is a natural valley notable for its mountainous scenery and mild climate. It attracts lovers of off-road trips and those who enjoy the beautiful natural views of this charming governorate.

98080096.s: Wadi Bidah in Ma'shouqah Governorate is home to Ma'shouqah Dam, the fourth dam in this valley, which lies in the lands of the Zahran tribe. It is surrounded by a stunning mountain view that can be seen from the top of the neighboring mountain, along with birds such as the heron. The dam area is hard to reach and requires driving on rough dirt roads. Contact: 0556867078.

98080095.s: Safa Maean Waterfall in Bani Kabir Governorate is a natural site offering a fairly thrilling driving experience along a rugged mountain road that is narrow in some sections. At its start is a natural pool, resembling a rock dam, where water collects. Visiting requires a four-wheel-drive vehicle and driving skill, and the round trip takes more than two hours, but it is worth the effort for adventure lovers.

98080094.s: Al Marzouq Waterfall is one of the most beautiful waterfalls in Bani Kabir Governorate. It has two sections: a lower section close to the waterfall that is hard for families and children to reach, and an upper section with a calm stream suitable for everyone. Cars can reach the site directly. Visitors are advised to bring young people and adventurers to enjoy its full beauty, while taking care around the surrounding rocks.

98080092.s: Wadi Mahla in Qilwah Governorate is a quiet natural site for lovers of off-road trips and exploration. Its mountain scenery and varied terrain appeal to photography and camping enthusiasts.

98080087.s: Wadi Barahrah is one of the most beautiful natural valleys in Al Mandaq Governorate. It is known for its stunning scenery and a rough sandy track that calls for a four-wheel-drive vehicle to reach its deeper areas. The valley is at its most beautiful when water flows abundantly in the rainy season, and visitors are advised to take the necessary precautions.
